newsitem.title: CHINA: China to boost fertiliser output to 37 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China to boost fertiliser output to 37 mln tonnes.

text.p: China is seeking to raise its annual production capacity of chemical fertilisers to 37 million tonnes by the year 2000, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.

Nitrogenous fertiliser production would be raised to 23.7 million tonnes, that of phosphate fertiliser to 6.89 million tonnes and potash fertiliser to 600,000 tonnes, the newspaper quoted the Ministry of Chemical Industry as saying.
China aimed to be self-sufficient in nitrogenous fertiliser and would import appropriate amounts of phosphate and potash fertilisers, the ministry said without elaborating.
The sector should renovate small and medium-sized plants and improve channels of securing raw materials to boost production, it said but gave no further details.
China produced 23.3 million tonnes of chemical fertiliser in 1995 and output rose 10.3 percent in January-September of last year to hit 19.1 million tonnes, official figures show.
